# Engin3D

Use this skill when developing or fixing code for `src/client/Engin3D` .NET MAUI main client project.

## MAUI client project

The dedicated MAUI project is `src/client/Engin3D` and uses .NET 10, .NET MAUI, CommunityToolkit.Mvmm, CommunityToolkit.Maui and UraniumUI and their dependencies.
